answer: An agent marketplace grants one job bid per minute to each identity that locks $1,000 for 30 days. Each bond stays bound to one identity for the full term, so accounts named harbor, trellis, and velvet need three separate bonds to obtain three quotas. Every additional fake identity ties up another $1,000. At a 1% financing rate per 30 days, its marginal cost is $10 for that term, even if the principal is later returned.
